mcq.q: What is the primary difference between a structure and a self-referential structure in C

options.A: Self-referential structures can only store integers
options.C: Self-referential structures contain pointers to structures of the same type
options.D: Structures are dynamic, while self-referential structures are static

mcq.answer_text: Self-referential structures contain pointers to structures of the same type
